events.summary: Speaker C presented the clay prototype: a snail shape, compact, blue with yellow and multi-coloured buttons.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: This is a model of the remote control which we are going to build

events.summary: Speaker C said the case is plastic and the buttons are soft rubber, because users touch them often.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: for the buttons it is uh s soft rubber

events.summary: Speaker C said the light emitting diode is fluorescent green, and the infrared bulb is like an ordinary one.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: for the light emitting diode it is a fluorescent green

events.summary: Speaker B said the prototype includes an on/off button.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: Now we have included the switch on and off button

events.summary: Speaker B said the prototype includes a mute button on the side.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: Now we have included another feature that is the mute button

events.speaker: B
events.quote: Then we have included one to nine buttons

events.quote: our model also contains a button which is called as the menu button

events.speaker: B
events.quote: We have also included a button which is called as the swapping button
